description: Bug classes planted by the seeded-bug eval. Each class names the checklist item that should catch it.

classes.name: wrong_divider_value
classes.mutation: Change one resistor of a feedback, enable or UVLO divider by a decade or to the wrong unit (k to ohm).

classes.name: bead_cap_resonance_near_fsw
classes.mutation: Remove the damping element of a bead filter, or change its capacitor so the undamped LC resonance lands within a factor of 1.5 of a nearby switching frequency.

classes.name: strap_both_sides_fitted
classes.mutation: Mark both the pull-up and pull-down of a two-level strap as fitted in the released variant.

classes.name: regulator_outside_example_envelope
classes.mutation: On an internally compensated regulator, move L, COUT, VIN or fsw well outside every datasheet example for that compensation mode, with no Cff or compensation footprint.

classes.name: missing_pullup
classes.mutation: Delete the pull-up of an open-drain output or an I2C line.

classes.name: tvs_standoff_below_rail
classes.mutation: Swap a TVS for the next lower standoff voltage so VRWM sits below the rail's worst-case maximum.

classes.name: upstream_cannot_sink
classes.mutation: Set a downstream synchronous converter to forced-continuous mode while its upstream regulator cannot sink current and the rail has no other load or clamp.
